name: Claude accounts manager
author: Brett
description: One ordered list of every Claude account on the VPS, subscription logins and API keys alike: number in the order, name, email, plan, subscription or API, active builder / worker / not, out of credits, usage used and left in percent and in dollars. A Custom / Automatic switch: Custom = drag and drop sets the order the build orchestrator follows exactly (API is an entry like any other); Automatic = subscriptions first, then API. Rename, add a subscription or API key (opens the Terminal and starts the login or the key prompt), right-click any account for a Claude Code session as that account. Adds a collapsible accounts column to the Terminal, a configurable banner widget with a drop-down, and a floating overlay window with custom buttons and sub-menus (resizable, size lock, docking, minimize, console or whole-screen scope). Never shows a credential.

items.title: List every Claude account in order
items.description: Every Claude account on the VPS in the order the build orchestrator follows (subscriptions and API keys alike): number, name, email, plan, subscription or API, active builder / worker / not, out of credits and why, usage used and left in percent and dollars, plus totals. Never a credential.

items.title: Claude account order: Custom or Automatic
items.description: The switch: custom = the orchestrator follows the drag-and-drop account order exactly (subscriptions and API alike); auto = subscriptions first, then any API. Also the order followed now and the saved custom order.

items.title: Switch the Claude account order between Custom and Automatic
items.description: custom = follow the drag-and-drop order exactly; auto = subscriptions first, then any API; toggle flips it (voice: 'account order automatic', 'use my custom account order'). Switching to auto while an API account is outside the custom order lets it bill per token: Brett's own click. The custom order is kept either way.

items.title: Read the Claude account order
items.description: The account order the build orchestrator follows now: mode (custom or auto), the order followed (names, first = tried first), the saved custom order and which accounts are in it. Same answer as the console action claude-accounts-manager.order, the CLI and voice ('what is my account order').

items.title: Set the Claude account order
items.description: The whole custom order (followed while the switch is on Custom; saved but not followed on Automatic), first = tried first. API keys are entries like any subscription. Adding an API account or moving one earlier is Brett's own click (it bills per token); anyone may move one later or take it out.

items.title: Move one Claude account in the order
items.description: Move one account up, down, to the top or bottom, out of the order, or to a position (voice: 'move account 3 to the top'). Give to (or position, the same thing; the CLI uses --position).

name.description: account name, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes ('account 2' works)

to.description: up, down, top, bottom, out or a position (1 = first)

position.description: same as to (the CLI's name for it: --position top)

items.title: Reset the Claude account order
items.description: Clear the custom order and set the switch to Custom: with no order the orchestrator takes subscriptions first, then any ready API account while API overflow is on. Never puts an API key earlier, so a session, MCP or voice may do it (voice: 'reset my account order').

items.title: Rename a Claude account
items.description: Give an account a display name (voice: 'call account 3 Hulu'). The saved login keeps its name.

name.description: account name, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes ('account 2' works)

items.title: Add a Claude account or API key
items.description: Add a subscription login (Claude login in its own folder) or an API key (typed at the VPS host's hidden prompt, never here). In the console it opens the Terminal and starts the login; from MCP or voice set signin=true to send the held sign-in.

name.description: account name, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes ('account 2' works)

items.title: Open Claude Code as an account
items.description: The Terminal tab that runs Claude Code on the VPS host as this account (its own copy of the login). Run the console action it returns to open it.

name.description: account name, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes ('account 2' works)

items.title: Claude accounts manager settings
items.description: Banner widget (account, what it shows), Terminal column (on, open), floating overlay (open, scope console|os, dock, minimized, size lock, position, size, buttons with actions and sub-menus) and plan prices.

items.title: Change Claude accounts manager settings
items.description: Patch any section: widget {on, account, show: number|name|left|kind|email|plan|status|dollars}, column {on, open}, overlay {open, scope, dock, minimized, locked, x, y, w, h, opacity, buttons}, prices {plan: monthly USD}, accountPrices {name: monthly USD}.

items.title: Claude account banner widget
items.description: What the banner widget shows now and for which account.

keeps: the account order: a build orchestrator setting (pipeline-settings@1 order)
the saved logins and API keys on the VPS host (/root/.claude-accounts)
